title: Figure 1: CAPELLA Data Warehouse concept diagram
description: Block diagram titled "DATA WAREHOUSE" showing six database cylinders labeled Catalog 1 through Catalog 6 linked via a central "Links" node to "Internal Data bases" and "Web," and to a column of media types: Photographs, Radar data, Recordings, Videos, Maps and Satellite views. The caption reads "Figure 1: Data Warehouse concept." Surrounding text discusses using Excel for flat files, embedded bias in private UFO case catalogues, and an estimate of about 100,000 total sighting cases; the footer reads "CAPELLA Data Warehouse, page 6."
